verses.text: By David. The LORD is my light and my salvation. Who should I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life. Who could frighten me?
When evildoers came to devour me, my enemies and attackers were the ones who stumbled and fell.
Even if an army camps against me, my heart won’t fear. Even if war breaks out against me, I’ll still stand confident.
I’ve asked the LORD for one thing, and I’ll keep seeking it: to live in his house all my days, to see his beauty and seek him in his temple.
When trouble comes, he’ll keep me safe in his shelter. He’ll hide me deep inside his tent and set me high on a rock.
Then my head will rise above the enemies around me. I’ll offer sacrifices with shouts of joy in his tent and sing praises to the LORD.
Hear me when I cry out, LORD. Have mercy on me and answer me.
When you said, “Seek my face,” my heart answered, “LORD, I’ll seek your face.”
Don’t hide your face from me or send your servant away in anger. You’ve been my help. Don’t leave me or abandon me, God who saves me.
Even if my father and mother leave me, the LORD will take me in.
Teach me your way, LORD. Lead me on a straight path with my enemies around me.
Don’t hand me over to what my enemies want. False witnesses have risen against me, breathing threats.
I still believe I’ll see the LORD’s goodness in the land of the living.
Wait for the LORD. Be strong and take heart. Yes, wait for the LORD.
